In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this study provides a new method for the preparation and characterization of porous films of {M72Fe30}(DDMA)3 vesicle frameworks.
this study has demonstrated a novel method for the formation and self-patterning of the porous films consisting giant vesicles.

the self-patterning of giant vesicles into the porous film materials consisting {Mo72Fe3O}(DODMA), which are the first examples of self-assembled porous materials from the giant vesicles, can be obtained.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the giant vesicles formed from the {Mo72}(Fe30) macroanion and the DODMA cation can be used to form self-patterning, porous films as frameworks in organic solvent and water, respectively.
the giant vesicles are the promising candidates of self-assembly materials and their self-patterning into the porous films are the promising templates for in-situ synthesis and catalysis.
the porous films consisting giant vesicles can be prepared by the simple and effective method, and the porous films can be used for many applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the porous films consisting the giant vesicles are highly ordered and the vesicles are stable in the films.
the porous films consisting vesicle frameworks are a new type of self-patterining porous films with the potential to be used as a new material in many fields.
the vesicles of POM complexes are very promising materials for fabricating self-patterning of the porous films.
